Owner::start refuses a bundle whose cache, registration and volume serve different storages, the owner's PUT path begins each fill on its own volume's storage, and Owner::receive_fill and Owner::publish_fill have no non-test caller; the soak driver builds its reader, volume and fills from one Storage, so no foreign registration, lease or volume reaches these checks.

No profile seeds a shard record whose page_cap is below page_len(0), the encoded empty coverage page: every fencer a profile or history runs (put_tests::fenced_coverage, covered_successors::fence_over) builds its Fencing over store_tests::record_under, whose page_cap is 4096.

Every storage call a profile makes carries at least 1024 work steps (OWNER.lookup_work 1024 for lookups, joins, observations and reservations, 4096 for publication and invalidation, 4096 or 1 << 20 for the worlds' direct calls), enough for every shard chain walk, and no profile sets a smaller lookup_work or publish_work.

SpdkDisk, the only Disk of the non-test build, reports the geometry NamespaceFacts::limits accepted: a capacity and a transfer of at least one 4096-byte IO_UNIT, in whole IO_UNITs, and a queue depth of at least 1, so DeviceGeometry::validate never refuses ZeroCapacity, ZeroMaxTransfer or ZeroQueueDepth.

SpdkDisk, the only Disk of the non-test build, overrides check_reservation_report and always holds Some(reservation_limits), so the trait defaults and CommandTable's Unsupported arms never return, and submit_reservation discards its eager ok_or argument without returning Unsupported.

No code of the non-test build submits to a command table after its quiesce reported Stopped: Volume::close sets closed, which every volume submit path checks first, and the host fencer's stop_table runs before release_idle, which submits nothing afterward.

Every profile's storage comes from owner_fixture's configuration in the Fixture shape (128 payload units, 8 slots, 8 KiB record chunks) or the Scaled shape (256 payload units, 16 slots, 16 KiB chunks), with 4096-byte pages, 64-byte metadata and 49,152-byte body caps, 8 object rights, node 0, TEST_CLOCK and TEST_FEED, and no profile builds one that StorageConfig::validate, ClockContract::validate, FeedContract::validate or RecordConfig::validate refuses: a page size that is no valid alignment, a missing metadata cap, object rights below 2 or at REFS_MAX, caps whose largest object overflows the layout, passes the object limit or misfits the first window, a zero raw size or one that is no IO_UNIT multiple or too large, zero slots, metadata units, reserve or read ops, metadata units that leave no payload, a largest record above the payload or a reserve that with it passes the payload, alloc_search_words outside its bound, a slot_count above ERA_STAMP_RESERVE with enough alloc_search_words to pass the allocator check before it, a slot_count at TABLE_INDEX_LIMIT, watermarks outside their ranges, an empty node set, block_roots above ROOT_LIMIT, a zero clock uncertainty or provenance or too large a rate error, a zero feed authority or contract, or a zero record chunk or one that is no unit multiple.

No profile serves from the Cramped geometry or another storage small enough to fill: every profile runs the Fixture or Scaled shape, whose floor_marks watermarks and owner PUT limit keep a free object slot and the clean reserve for every admitted upload whose claim passes the retired-pressure check.

On the store behind a versioned cluster-swarm cell, no profile schedules a SimStore arm other than Pass (LostWrite, for example, acknowledges a write it does not apply, so the coverage reread after the next refused write reads below the client's mark) or an actor outage, fails the MemLog watermark log, writes undecodable record bytes, or gives the store another namespace before a shard-record operation, of which the cell's create_shard at seeding is the only one (coverage pages carry no namespace), so every store read and write the client issues succeeds as written.

No profile runs a second writer on the SimStore of a versioned cluster-swarm cell or schedules a SimStore arm other than Pass there, so each exact-version coverage page write conditions on the current version and Client::submit never receives Outcome::NotCommitted, and none repeats Client::create_shard on a store whose coverage page already holds another value or a version above Version::FIRST.

No profile scripts a submit refusal on the simulated device (SimControl::try_refuse_next), a table depth equal to the device queue depth keeps it from refusing QueueFull, and it offers no reservation commands, so no read, upload write or reservation submit meets a driver refusal.

No profile requires a tenure's suffix log, which only a warm install (Volume::install) or a capture proof (Storage::cut_intact from the host Duties loop) does, so no publication or removal frames or appends a suffix record through SuffixLog::frame and SuffixLog::record.

Volume::attach charges the table's metadata to a trial copy of its budget before CommandTable::new, and the host fencer gives CommandTable::new a budget of exactly that charge, so the table's own charge never refuses Envelope.

SpdkDisk, the only Disk of the non-test build, always reports reservation limits, so gate_step's no-reservation branch never ends an attach Unfenced(Unsupported) there; in the measured test build every simulated attach meets that branch on SimDisk and passes through Fenced::assumed while fence::UNGATED holds, which no profile clears.

No profile ends an upload unpublished without a recorded failure (a PUT cancel, conflicting data, expiry or supersession at publication) while a GET is parked on its fill, and none lets a GET that joined a fill after its publication find the object gone at its read, the route of acquire::LeaseRefusal::Retired; the uncertain profile cancels uploads but issues no GET, and cluster profiles cancel only GETs.

No admitted PUT runs out of the volume's receive buffers, command table or write budget, or is refused space for its reservation or its run wait: the owner's PUT limit and maintenance's floor keep claimable units for every claim that passes the retired-pressure check, and no profile keeps retired extents unreturned up to the retired allowance, fragments free space below a fill's layout or places an object of two or more extents.

No profile keeps a remaining fragment of a granted PUT withheld until the owner processes the PUT's request deadline: the deferring and long suppliers defer at least their withhold count and then draw Supply or DeferSupply, and in the named run every upload was supplied before its deadline, while the never-supplying plan (withhold = u32::MAX) runs only in a unit test, so PutCore::tick never fails a granted PUT TimedOut.

No profile attaches a volume under a ServingAuthority that carries a WarmSource, so no owner restarts warm from a published checkpoint through Volume::begin_warm, warm_limits, SlotReader, load_guard and publish_restored; every incarnation, recovery profiles included, attaches through ServingAuthority::fixture and the cold bootstrap.

No profile leaves a receive retrying staged segments with fewer write commands than it submits: PutCore grants each call the table's free write room up to its 8 commands and 1 MiB a turn, and never calls receive with zero commands.

No fill write is submitted while the volume write share is spent (Volume::write_room is 0, past which PutCore never grants) or the device queue is full, and no object of several extents waits on a busy pool gate for its next locator.
